Footpad impact test on RS soil (Red Crushed Volcanic Scoria (narrowly graded)) at relative density 0; apparatus: subscale oblique impact test equipment; loading: vertical impact; M1 = 51 lbs.. Recorded: vertical force vs displacement. One of 2 tests drawn from the same figures.

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple"}
The measurements of this test have not been digitized yet; the setup and the source pages are indexed. The setup below rests on two agent readings of the report that were reconciled; no person has checked it yet. The test setup is incomplete: fill depth is not reported.
:::
